one_liner: Fathom (fathom.video AI notetaker) has a public REST API at api.fathom.ai/external/v1 with self-serve API keys on all plans including free, OAuth 2.0 for multi-user apps, webhooks, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys are generated in User Settings → API Access (user-scoped). OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow is available for multi-user integrations, but apps must be registered with Fathom first via the OAuth Setup Guide. The SDK also lists a bearerAuth scheme, which is the OAuth access token.
access_notes: API keys and webhooks are included on all plans, including free. There is no approval process for API keys. OAuth app registration is a lighter vendor step. Rate limit is 60 calls per minute. Some CRM-matched data needs a Business plan.
blocker_notes: No real blocker. Minor friction: OAuth needs app registration with Fathom, and the rate limit is low (60 requests per minute).
